title: How Octave built a secure multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock
summary: Octave built a secure, multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock, using Cohere Embed v4 for embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for isolated agent execution, to power a Complaint Triage Assistant that searches 2 billion regulated documents without crossing tenant boundarie
reason: AWS customer case study on building a multi-tenant app with Amazon Bedrock. It announces no new model, version, or capability (R1-1), no research artifact (R2-1), no financing/M&A/partnership or product launch (R3-1), no policy action (R4-1), and no open-source tool release (R5-1).
